@StatusList.notes: Pattern in ~45 compE classes: node = Contains(this+0x68,"statuses") ? Get(node,"statuses") : node; then Passive_ApplyStatusChildren 0x14076a160(this, node, target|0, excludeKeys, stackMult, 0, 0). It iterates EVERY child (children = "effects"): a child whose name is in excludeKeys (the component own keys, e.g. chance/threshold/tag/mana/delay) is skipped; every other child is decoded by DamageInstance::DecodeStatusApplication 0x1402bbab0 (.analysis/decompiled/StatusEntry_FromGon_0x2bbab0.c): scalar value = stacks (number or stat expression, eval via Character::eval_lambda), 2-element array = [stacks, chance], object = {stacks (default 1), chance (percent or expr, default 1)} plus the child itself as the status data node; then apply_status(childName, target, stacks*stackMult, data) when chance >= 1 or the roll passes. Statuses with chance < 1 that are not applied still run a pre-check path (0x140493190 flags).

statuses.note: if `statuses` is present its children are applied, otherwise the component node itself is the status list; every child (except the caller's excluded key names) is a status/effect name dispatched to apply_status 0x483120

@StatusesBlock.notes: Pattern used by ~45 Status*/Scaled* passives: node = Contains(this+0x68,"statuses") ? Get(...,"statuses") : this+0x68; FUN_14076a160(this, node, target, excludedNames, stacksMult, applier, ...) iterates the children, skips names in excludedNames (the class's own scalar keys, e.g. stacks/threshold/turns), parses each child with StatusEntry_FromGon 0x2bbab0 (child scalar = stacks, or {stacks, chance}, or [stacks chance]), rolls chance and calls apply_status_byname 0x483120 with stacks*stacksMult. So children are "effects".
